request_binding.scope: Durable search-quality telemetry, evidence-aware frozen yield ordering, advisory probable-sibling clustering, and provenance UX consuming CHG-170/CHG-113.
constraints: No merge or mutation of main.
Preserve the CHG-170 search profile, enabled families, compiled task identities, phase semantics, and deep recall coverage.
Do not add a duplicate qualification system or application-provenance model.
Production jobs.sqlite3 must not be used for validation.
No live LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ordinary-Chrome refresh, or receiver recovery validation.

migration.behavior: Additive and idempotent; freezes baseline/effective execution ranks and order rationale/sample metadata on tasks, stores ordering parameters on runs, and adds indexes for quality history, source-occurrence aggregation, event attribution, and sibling recency.

metric_dictionary.source_of_truth: Reproducible aggregation from browser_search_tasks, search_task_results, jobs, browser_events, application_events, and source_occurrences; no materialized metric cache.
metric_dictionary.source_occurrence_metrics: Supplemental profile/version/platform/family/kind/pass aggregation. source_occurrences has no task age-window or phase, so it is not used to fabricate those dimensions.
metric_dictionary.definitions: Full reproducible formulas and outcome-state rules are in docs/SEARCH_QUALITY.md and are exposed by /api/search-quality.

attribution_rule.occurrence_yield: Every persisted task result remains visible in task metrics, including repeated sightings and cards that map to an already-known canonical job.
attribution_rule.canonical_yield: Distinct canonical job_id within a query/family metric grouping; exact query rows may overlap when the same job was seen by multiple tasks.
attribution_rule.downstream_funnel: Each canonical job-stage is counted once per strategy profile + profile version + platform + query family. Credit it to the discovery with earliest first_seen_at, then lowest task_id, then lowest result_id. Query kind/pass, phase, and age window do not create extra copies of the same downstream stage.
attribution_rule.fixture_proof: Seeded duplicate and cross-query sightings credit the application, screen, interview, and offer once to the earliest logical-family discovery; later phase/platform/query rows do not multiply them.

ordering.positive_signal: Distinct canonical jobs with both CHG-113 evidence_readiness_state=READY and qualification_readiness_state=READY and a CHG-170 actionable recommendation.
ordering.history_eligibility: Completed or partial detail outcomes linked to durable READY, REVIEW, or BLOCKED evidence and qualification states; raw card volume is not a positive signal.
ordering.score: Pooled-prior shrinkage estimate of qualified outcomes per pages-plus-detail-reads cost; compare using configured Wilson confidence intervals and minimum effect guardrail.
ordering.fallback: If any peer task is below sample sufficiency, intervals overlap/contradict, or displacement exceeds the guardrail, preserve baseline execution order exactly.
ordering.scheduling_scope: Within existing phase/platform peer groups only. Every task and identity remains queued; effective ranks occupy existing baseline rank slots. The run freezes config, reason, and sample at enqueue. Existing phase progression, platform waves, leases, checkpoints, stop/resume, and human waits remain in force.

seeded_before_after.result: Strong trusted ready yield promotes query B despite lower raw volume; duplicate zero-qualified query A does not promote by card count.
seeded_before_after.insufficient_and_contradictory_history: Seeded below-floor samples and overlapping 95% Wilson intervals both retain baseline A then B order and ranks.

task_universe_and_recall.evidence: Isolated test compiles the integrated CHG-170 staged plan, verifies 140 task identities before and after ordering, asserts every enabled minimum_deep_recall family/platform pair remains present in C_DEEP_BACKFILL, and observes baseline ranks when history is insufficient.

probable_sibling_fixtures.basis: Normalized employer/title, compatible location/remote bucket, posted dates within 30 days, and distinct verified ATS requisitions explicitly retained as separate related jobs.
probable_sibling_fixtures.output: Advisory cluster carries algorithm/version, confidence, basis, and member canonical job IDs; no destructive controls.

surfaces: full underlying evidence JSON remains included

fixture_states.remote: INFERRED_OR_DERIVED when value exists without a durable observation marker
fixture_states.salary: INFERRED_OR_DERIVED when value exists without a durable observation marker
fixture_states.employment_type: INFERRED_OR_DERIVED when value exists without a durable observation marker
fixture_states.application_destination: OBSERVED and separately verified using CHG-113 destination state

provenance_ux_proof.dashboard_controls: Sibling display and inspection only; no merge controls.

tests.focused_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.integration.test_chg114_search_quality tests.integration.test_browser_tasks tests.integration.test_dashboard_exports_application tests.integration.test_database_ledger tests.unit.test_chg113_evidence_readiness tests.unit.test_qualification_gates tests.unit.test_strategy -q
tests.migration_idempotence: Verified by isolated SQLite fixture; second migration call applies no migration and added task-order columns are present.
tests.existing_hard_gate_and_readiness: Focused CHG-113 evidence readiness, CHG-170 qualification gate, strategy, task, database, and dashboard/export suites passed.
